review_kind: Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-13 of the label and tooltip of ops_ph_placement_seed (item 940 part 2, branch claude-ops-e2e-test-1113) against the exact English source. No human or native-speaker signoff.

retired_records.source: A phenotype placement seed: a JSON file with the well's phenotype raster, scale and rotation from an earlier full run (schema spacr.ops_ph_placement_seed). With it the phenotype phase aligns no anchor fields: every field is placed from the file, moved onto this run's stitch by the sequencing tiles the file lists, so a run on a few fields at the well's rim can be placed. Its report says 'placement: seeded'. Empty aligns anchors as usual. Alpha.
retired_records.translation: 表型放置种子：一个 JSON 文件，包含先前完整运行得到的该孔表型栅格、缩放比例和旋转（模式 spacr.ops_ph_placement_seed）。使用它时，表型阶段不对齐任何锚定视野：每个视野都按文件放置，并借助文件列出的测序图块移到本次运行的拼接上，因此在孔边缘少数视野上的运行也能完成放置。其报告会注明 'placement: seeded'。留空则照常对齐锚点。Alpha 功能。
retired_records.retired: 2026-11-14: item 947 follow-up (claude-947-multiacq-1114 branch: the tooltips shortened to the 600-character ceiling, and the placement seeds' stated default, that tests/test_tooltip_length_and_shape.py asks for) changed this English source; its successor is reviewed in 2026-11-14-ph-use-acquisition-947-ai-review.json.
